matches.how: Consuelo Salyards retained the InterNet Championship over Billy Smith, the man she had won it from, with a crucifix, in the third of three defenses on the card.

A Triangle Ladder match for the OWA Championship, the main event: Traci Lane retrieved the title from the top of the ladder; the OWA Commissioner overruled Anthony Hazard's attempt to claim it after it fell into his hands, and suspended Hazard two weeks for missing his earlier Respect Match commitment.

The Crew (Shogun, Executioner & Stacks Coltrain) retained the OWA Trio Tag Team Championship over MP Inc (Big Russ Gator, Kodiak & Nazghul) when Shogun pinned Gator; a legal-man dispute with Kodiak followed the finish.
A First Blood match: Blackout drew blood with a facebite.
A Graffiti match: Harvard Earl retrieved the spray can and wrote "You Lose" on Danny Bouchard's back, 14:55.
A Press Your Luck qualifier: Asian Invasion won by disqualification after Masked Plague struck him with Pooh.
A Press Your Luck qualifier: "Diamond" Brett Robbins won with a turnbuckle Brainbuster, 2:32.
Consuelo Salyards retained the InterNet Championship over Rainbow Warrior with a sunset flip, in the second of three defenses on the card.

appearances.source: the broadcast's own credits, served at /promotions/owa-online/archive/owa-crime-spree-ppv-part-1.html

matches.how: A no-DQ, no-referee-count bar brawl (the stipulation: incapacitate both opponents). The Extremists (Danny Maxx & Johnny Blades) were awarded the win by referee's count over Rachel Ryan & Wendy Ryker; all four wrestlers were hospitalized afterward.

A Respect Match: Davey Scott faced a rotation of OWA wrestlers in two-minute intervals. He pinned Asian Invasion inside his own window, survived the rest, and was finally pinned with the Drop Piledriver by a returning Gustaffson.
Consuelo Salyards retained the InterNet Championship over Tom Tomorrow with a rollup, 19:28, in the first of three defenses on the card.
"The Enforcer" Adam Sanchez won a Boston Crab submission over Nightmare, 6:24, in his first match back in the OWA after a long absence.

name: OWA Championship Wrestling, 5 January 1997

matches.how: The Shocker was awarded the match by disqualification after Tara Quinn hit him with repeated low blows before the opening bell was even rung.
Ricky Hype defeated Tom Tomorrow with a waistlock suplex after ringside interference from Johnny Fate, Anthony Hazard, and Freddy Fever left Tomorrow without a cornerman.

The Extremists (Danny Maxx & Johnny Blades) attacked Rachel Ryan & Gustaffson before the bell in this OWA Tag Team Championship contender's match; the brawl spilled to the floor and the referee called for the bell with no decision.

Shogun retained the OWA TV Championship over Mr. America by disqualification after Asian Invasion interfered at ringside; the match's aftermath saw America, Invasion, and Chaos beat down Freddy Fever together and declare themselves the Evil Empire.

notes: Opened with a Grand Prix standings report (Freddy Fever leading at 115 points, very early in the tournament); closed with Mr. America, Asian Invasion, and Chaos declaring themselves the Evil Empire after turning on Freddy Fever.
